purpose: absolute current of the single unit branch and the decoded level set at the lowest code
observe_nodes: clamp_node current (iprobe), iref_in, vdd18, vss, Xdut.en0..en7, the eight XuN.vbias_ch
measure_interval: whole clamp sweep; the 1.2 V point is read off the sweep, not assumed
reference_definition: Iref = 15 uA injected into the diode-connected Mref; theoretical unit = Iref x (2.5/2)/(20/2)
failure_condition: branch current outside the candidate tolerance band, or en0 low, or any other branch's local bias node charged

purpose: second code: two unit branches on
failure_condition: mask not equal to the hand-written golden row G02, or non-monotonic step from DC-000
mask mismatch G03 or step error beyond the candidate DNL

purpose: fifth code; the case that breaks if select1 is reused where pam1|pam0 is meant
failure_condition: more than five branches on, i.e. gor10 replaced by sel1 in Xsel5

purpose: full scale: eight branches, expected to equal the accepted 15 uA single-channel current
observe_nodes: clamp_node current, iref_in, all eight local bias nodes
reference_definition: full scale is the shared reference itself, so normalisation is against Iref and not against a fitted value
failure_condition: total below the candidate full-scale band, or one branch not contributing (a branch whose DATA_OUT is not on data_out)

purpose: long pulse at code 111: delivered charge per window, settling into band, shutoff
observe_nodes: clamp_node current, data_out, iref_in, XuN.vbias_ch of every branch
measure_interval: from before the enable rise to after the enable fall plus the tail; band entry and exit by adjacent-sample interpolation
reference_definition: theoretical Q = target current x window; also measured against the same case's own static current
failure_condition: never entering the band, entering after the window deadline, or a shutoff tail beyond the candidate leak limit

purpose: 120 ns short pulse at a representative code (Hybrid spacing at 100 Hz)
observe_nodes: clamp_node current, data_out, one local bias node per selected branch
measure_interval: the 120 ns platform, plus 200 ns after it
failure_condition: charge error per pulse beyond the candidate band; sampled-versus-interpolated edge disagreement larger than maxstep

purpose: 200 ns short pulse at the same code (Hybrid spacing at 60 Hz)
measure_interval: the 200 ns platform, plus 400 ns after it
failure_condition: same, and the 120-to-200 charge ratio must stay inside the candidate linearity band

purpose: enable shutoff and code changes made only inside the off window: 011 to 100 and 000 to 111
observe_nodes: Xdut.en0..en7, the eight local bias nodes, clamp_node current
measure_interval: one off window plus the following emission window
failure_condition: a code changing while the output conducts, or a local bias node still charged at the start of the next window (bleed not working)

purpose: same stimulus as DC-000 with a finer sweep step near the 1.2 V region
measure_interval: 0.9 V to 1.5 V at the finer step
failure_condition: a result that moves more than the candidate resolution between the two steps, i.e. the coarse step was not converged

purpose: same stimulus as DC-111 with a finer sweep step
observe_nodes: clamp_node current, all local bias nodes
measure_interval: 0.9 V to 1.5 V at the finer step
failure_condition: full-scale value not reproduced within the candidate resolution

purpose: same stimulus as TR-OFFCODE with a smaller maxstep
observe_nodes: enable nets, local bias nodes, clamp_node current
measure_interval: same windows as the paired case
failure_condition: a transient feature that appears only at one maxstep, i.e. not resolved; identical input edge timing does NOT prove the analog current converged
